summary: Audit 09-20: 40 findings; its plan 0.1-3.15 claims 25 items done, 5 partial, 4 human or not done. One claimed-done item, the MAX_BOOT_RAW_KB gate (3.9/F16), is absent from the code. PSI track since 09-29: PR #419-#431, f792321, round 1 b006c2e (:has removed, fixture TBT 557->343 ms), round 2 81d84b1 (boot 566.7->480.3 KB gzip; gtag policy C5). Round-3 plan: #1 and #2 done; #3-#8 open; #7 partly done. Gates on .output: chunks, entry-purity, server-entry-purity, ssr-budgets (all ceilings exactly at limit, including 11 dehydrated entries), loader-policy, menu-icons and the vitest gates are green. check:bundle is RED: overall 4806.8 > 4772 KB, driven by spreadsheet.worker +139.8 KB; CSS 95.5/96 KB (0.5 KB headroom); boot 477.1/579 KB gzip (102 KB of unratcheted slack); raw boot 1568 KB is not gated. format:check is red on one test file (fixed in PR #466). Disagreements: gtag item already done; experimentalMinChunkSize is 2048, not 512; updatedAt:0 seeds are fallback-only doctrine; przyczyny.md lines 290-564 are a corrupted duplicate.

findings.claim: check:bundle is red on main: the OVERALL budget is exceeded by 34.8 KB. Public, largest-chunk, CSS and boot budgets pass. The breach comes from admin/worker chunks (spreadsheet.worker new +139.8 KB, i18n-event-front +10.2, admin.seo +7.5), not the public boot path.
findings.evidence: bun run check:bundle on .output: 'overall total 4806.8 KB > 4772 KB'; scratchpad/phase1/prior-art/check-bundle.txt; budgets at scripts/check-bundle-size.ts:1752-2045 (chunk 286, public 2877, overall 4772, css 96, publicCss 83, boot 579)
findings.metric: CI gate (none of the LH metrics)

findings.claim: The CSS budget has 0.5 KB headroom (95.5/96 KB gzip). Any wave that moves inline <style> into stylesheets, or adds CSS, fails check:bundle unless it removes at least as much in the same change.
findings.evidence: check-bundle.txt 'Client CSS: 4 files, 95.5 KB gzip (budget ≤ 96 KB)', public CSS 80.6/83; audit §8.2 line 591 already warned of 0.3 KB headroom

findings.claim: Raw boot bytes (the parse/compile cost on 4x CPU) are reported but not gated, although the audit's §8.1 marks 3.9 (including the MAX_BOOT_RAW_KB gate) as done. The boot gzip budget of 579 KB was never ratcheted after round 2 (measured 477.1), leaving 102 KB of slack that later regressions can spend silently.
findings.evidence: scripts/check-bundle-size.ts:2470-2480 ('Raportowane, NIE bramkowane' = reported, not gated); AUDYT §8.1 row 3.9 (line 556) vs §5.1 F16 (line 344); boot closure 477.1 KB gzip / 1568.0 KB raw

findings.claim: The round-3 item 'gtag after interaction/consent with TTI fallback' listed as planned in EVIDENCE §7 is already implemented (C5, gtagLoadPolicy.ts). What remains is that its fallback (load+2 s, then 1.5 s without long tasks, cap 8 s) still fires inside Lighthouse's TBT window. Pushing it further conflicts with the stated rule 'do not defer work solely beyond the audit window' and with the accepted page_view trade-off, so it is a product decision.
findings.evidence: 81d84b1 body C5; src/lib/analytics/gtagLoadPolicy.ts:14-38,40-52 (QUIET_AFTER_LOAD_MS 2000, LONG_TASK_QUIET_MS 1500, LOAD_CAP_MS 8000); docs/performance/2026-09-30-critical-boot.md:5; EVIDENCE §4 gtag at ~5.8 s

findings.claim: The team's plan #3 (replace updatedAt:0 SSR seeds with the render time to kill 11-15 refetches) rests on a partly wrong premise. updatedAt:0 is applied only when SSR got no data, plus the unconditional post_layout_settings seed, and it is defended doctrine: without it the Header rendered null for the whole visit. On a healthy HIT the refetches must come from queries that are never prefetched or dehydrated, or from staleTime. Attribute each call first.
findings.evidence: src/routes/__root.tsx:659-699 (comment and seeds guarded by !getQueryData); src/lib/ssr/resilientLoad.ts:148; docs/performance/2026-10-02-pagespeed-przyczyny.md:617; AUDYT F36 (line 443) list of non-dehydrated hooks

findings.claim: EVIDENCE §10 states experimentalMinChunkSize 512, but both configs use 2048. Chunk-fragmentation analysis and any manualChunks proposal must start from 2048.
findings.metric: LCP/FCP via request count and bandwidth (post-boot wave)

findings.claim: Regression vector: the Lovable bot commits directly to main (78 of 245 commits since 10-02) and has reintroduced banned patterns. 9ac8117 added :has() to styles.css and turned main red until 533f849. Every implementation wave must rebase and re-run gates; gates are the only defence.
findings.evidence: git log origin/main --since=2026-10-02 --format=%an (gpt-engineer-app[bot] 78); git show 9ac8117 (src/styles.css +8); 533f849 body

check:ssr-budgets ceilings are all exactly at their limits, including 'dehydrated entries 11 (ceiling 11, __root.tsx)'. Any html-weight change to dehydration must stay at or under 11 and may ratchet it down. One Promise.all at __root.tsx:859 is statically unmeasurable.

Worktrees created from HEAD will not contain these files, and a new check:* script needs a workflow step (check:gate-coverage).

findings.claim: Speculation rules use eagerness 'moderate' for prefetch and prerender (hover/pointer triggered), so there is no eager prefetch competing during load. The EVIDENCE §6 open question is closed.

changes.title: Bundle gate: chronicle entry XXII, ratchet boot 579 -> ~485 KB, make check:bundle green by measured cause
changes.mechanism: Following the chronicle convention (entries V, XII, XX), measure the overall breach per chunk (spreadsheet.worker/xlsx host-runner skew, admin.seo, i18n-event-front) and either cut it or re-floor OVERALL with the measured cause. Ratchet boot down to measured 477.1 KB + 0.5% + 1 KB so perf waves cannot spend the slack. Refresh the baseline from a green runner log.
changes.expected_effect: Main goes green on the build job; future boot regressions above ~485 KB fail CI
changes.estimate_basis: check-bundle.txt measured 477.1 KB boot, 4806.8 KB overall; chronicle formula in check-bundle-size.ts:1730-1740
changes.verification: bun run check:bundle on build:smoke exits 0; CI build job green; the moves report shows the per-chunk causes

changes.title: Gate raw boot bytes (bootRaw) as a sixth frozen budget
changes.mechanism: Add bootRaw to FROZEN_BUDGET_KB (floor about 1568 KB raw + 0.5%) and fail when it is exceeded. Parse/compile cost on Moto G Power 4x scales with raw bytes, not gzip. This implements the audit item 3.9 that was marked done without the code.
changes.expected_effect: No direct score change; prevents raw boot regressions that erase boot-js wins
changes.verification: Negative control test: an artificially enlarged boot chunk fails; the real artifact passes

changes.title: Productise the document-weight gate draft as check:document-weight (ratchet-only)
changes.mechanism: Commit the untracked draft and wire it into a workflow step (required by check:gate-coverage) and into the verify-static artifact-only list. Thresholds only ratchet down after each html-weight or lcp-path wave.
changes.metric: FCP, SI, LCP mobile (HTML bytes, inline CSS, duplicate preloads)
changes.expected_effect: Locks in html-weight reductions; no direct score change
changes.estimate_basis: document-weight-budgets.json measured html 391114 B raw, 54475 B gzip, 50 inline styles of 132888 B
changes.verification: Gate passes on the baseline artifact and fails with an injected 10 KB inline style

changes.title: Attribute every post-hydration PostgREST call before touching updatedAt:0 seeds
changes.mechanism: Measure (LH network-requests or a CDP probe on a HIT document) which query keys refetch after hydration, and classify each as fallback seed, unconditional post_layout_settings seed, non-dehydrated query, or staleTime 0. Change only those that are not the documented self-healing doctrine (__root.tsx:659-699).
changes.expected_effect: Removes the subset of 15 refetches that are not doctrine; size unknown until attributed
changes.verification: measure-ab.sh: count of PostgREST requests after hydration and TBT delta; the Header still renders after a simulated backend hiccup (existing tests)

changes.title: Update the on-demand-overlays Link-preload contract together with any preload trimming
changes.mechanism: When stray route chunks and duplicate LCP preloads are removed from the Link header, assert positively that the hero widget chunks are preloaded and negatively that admin.analytics, blog.index, EventPortalContent etc. are absent on /.
changes.expected_effect: Keeps the preload diet from regressing
changes.verification: Spec passes on the candidate and fails on the baseline for the negative assertions

changes.title: Repair the corrupted section of 2026-10-02-pagespeed-przyczyny.md in the implementation doc PR
changes.mechanism: Remove the duplicated lines 290-564 and rejoin the C4 table row with line 565.
changes.verification: prettier --check passes; the §8a table renders with rows C1-C5
